Definition: Chattush, the name of four or five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hattush names more than one man, and each is named for his place in the work. One is a son of Shechaniah in the line of David, another comes up with Ezra from Babylon, and another repairs the wall of Jerusalem by his own house.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the same name straight across the generations. Hattush in the genealogy, Hattush on the journey, and Hattush on the wall are all part of one story of return.
RelatedEvents: Ezra's Journey to Jerusalem; Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall
